summary: Option Care Health filed an 8-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger under which Onyx Bidco LLC—backed by an investor group of Clayton, Dubilier & Rice affiliates and McKesson Corporation—will acquire the company via merger of Onyx Merger Sub into Option Care, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. The board unanimously approved the deal, deemed it fair, and recommended stockholder adoption at a special meeting. Per-share consideration and premium are not stated in the excerpt; watch HSR clearance, stockholder vote timing and appraisal-risk overhang.
